summary_en: Commerce One Holdings approved the acquisition of up to 50,000 shares (0.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥45 million through market purchases from November 24, 2026 to May 13, 2027, based on a discretionary management strategy considering investment opportunities, financial position, and stock price levels.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 13, 2026, Commerce One Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 50,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.7% of outstanding shares (calculated from 6,873,851 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total outlay of ¥45 million. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases under a discretionary management agreement, with the execution period extending from November 24, 2026 to May 13, 2027. The authorization was granted under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act, as applied by reference to Article 156. The company stated it will pursue this strategic acquisition opportunistically, taking into comprehensive consideration the company's investment opportunities, financial condition, and prevailing stock price levels as part of its overall financial strategy. No specific maximum purchase price per share was announced; the ¥45 million ceiling implies an average acquisition cost ceiling of approximately ¥900 per share if the full 50,000-share authorization is executed.
